subject: AWS co-sell intro: Aurionix potential marketplace listing and joint account plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell intro: Aurionix potential marketplace listing and joint account plan

Hi Samir —

Hope you’re well. I’m reaching because we’ve been talking with Aurionix (Noah Reyes, cc) about a potential Redwood listing in the AWS Marketplace combined with an AWS co-sell motion. Aurionix is evaluating a pilot to embed Redwood-powered semantic search and assistant capabilities into their retail operations product. Early signals look promising and they’ve asked for an AWS-backstopped joint account plan so procurement and solution architecture can move in parallel.

High-level asks:
- Can you make a short intro to the AWS account team / SA who would own the co-sell for Aurionix’s account (Noah.reyes@aurionix.com)?
- Can we set a 30–45 minute joint account planning call next week to align on objectives, success metrics, procurement runway, and what an AWS Marketplace listing/co-sell enablement path looks like?
- I’m attaching a first-draft mutual action plan and our solution deck so you can see the scope (attachments below).

Suggested meeting objectives:
- Align on business outcomes (pilot scope + success metrics)
- Identify AWS resources required (SA, partner ops, procurement)
- Define mutual action plan and milestone owners

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 7/25 10:30–11:00
- Wed 7/26 14:00–14:45
- Thu 7/27 09:00–09:45

Ben Carter (cc) will join from Redwood as solutions lead. Karthik is looped to own commercial/partner coordination. Noah — if those windows don’t work for you, send two of your preferred times and we’ll flex.

Attachments: Aurionix_COsell_MAP_v1.pdf, redwood-aurionix-solution-deck.pptx

Thanks — appreciate any intro/help you can provide to get this moving.

—
Laura Bennett
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@amazon.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Noah Reyes <noah.reyes@aurionix.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro: Aurionix potential marketplace listing and joint account plan

Laura —

Thanks for reaching and for the materials; I skimmed the deck and MAP. Happy to help. A few quick clarifying points before I loop in the account team:

1) Procurement timeline — does Aurionix have a target purchase/PO window for the pilot? That helps us prioritize internal approvals.
2) Expected consumption shape — is this a small POC with a single environment or multi-region eval?
3) Any pre-existing relationship between Aurionix and an AWS account team (account owner name / account id) — if so, share the contact and I’ll coordinate.

I can introduce you to the AWS SA who typically handles retail ISVs in this segment (I’ll add Jeff Cole, Senior SA, in the intro). I can also bring a Partner SA from the marketplace team if we want to discuss listing mechanics.

Propose we tentatively hold Wed 7/26 14:00 PT — I’ll confirm once I hear back on the procurement timeline.

Samir
Samir Gupta
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
samir.gupta@amazon.com | +1 (206) 555-9021

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Noah Reyes <noah.reyes@aurionix.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jul 2028 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro: Aurionix potential marketplace listing and joint account plan

Samir — thanks, answering inline below and attaching the MAP/deck again for the AWS SA: 

1) Procurement timeline — Aurionix target is Q4 2028 for pilot PO (Noah confirms below). They want to complete procurement approvals by end of Sept to start a November pilot.

2) Consumption shape — initial pilot is single-region (us-west-2) with a small user cohort (10–15 concurrent workers); if pilot is successful they’ll scale multi-region and add embedding/semantic search workloads on an ongoing cadence.

3) Relationship — Aurionix does not have an existing AWS ISV relationship; they are new to marketplace licensing models. Noah, happy to share any billing/account details privately if helpful.

We’re happy for you to loop Jeff Cole (AWS SA) and the marketplace partner SA. Ben will lead the technical walkthrough and bring a short demo.

Confirmed availability from our side: Wed 7/26 14:00 PT works. If you can add Jeff and the marketplace partner SA, we’ll lock that slot.

Attachments: Aurionix_COsell_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), redwood-aurionix-solution-deck.pptx

—
Laura Bennett
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@amazon.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Noah Reyes <noah.reyes@aurionix.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jeff Cole <jeff.cole@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro: Aurionix potential marketplace listing and joint account plan

All —

Thanks for the details and for re-sending the MAP. I’ve looped Jeff Cole (AWS SA) and Priya Menon (Marketplace Partner SA) — priya will lead the listing discussion, jeff will cover architecture and pilot sizing.

Wed 7/26 14:00 PT is confirmed. I’ve booked a 45-minute slot and shared a calendar invite (see related links). Agenda: 1) intros & roles, 2) pilot scope + success metrics, 3) procurement timeline + marketplace listing path, 4) next steps & owners.

Noah — one ask before the meeting: can you share the current account id or the email used for billing so Jeff can check any existing permissions ahead of time? If you prefer, send via DM to preserve privacy.

See you all Wednesday.

Samir Gupta
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace

Attachments referenced in thread: Aurionix_COsell_MAP_v1.pdf, redwood-aurionix-solution-deck.pptx
